name: Canon EOS 5D Mark IV
photosites_source: Canon, Specifications (EOS 5D Mark IV), https://asia.canon/en/support/6200376100: L (Large) 6720 x 4480; image sensor 36.0 x 24.0 mm
source: Photons to Photos (Bill Claff), Read Noise in Electrons chart, series "Canon EOS 5D Mark IV_14" (14-bit raw): fwc, unityEv, loEv and the measured log2 read noise per ISO setting (ISO = 3.125 x 2^x), https://www.photonstophotos.net/Charts/RN_e.htm, fetched 2026-10-28
saturation_rule: the chart itself: saturation = fwc / 2^(isoEv - loEv) above the base ISO, i.e. halves per stop

not_modelled.prnu: no measurement found for this sensor; behind the ~12 photosites of a 1080p pixel it averages down by ~3.5x
not_modelled.quantisation: 14-bit at 4.29 e-/DN (ISO 100) adds 1.24 e- rms, beside 11.5 e- read noise
